metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from ProofBound: write and publish books, research sources, and turn photos into essays.

plugins.name: proofbound
plugins.description: Write a book in conversation with Claude, then publish it to your ProofBound library. ProofBound renders the PDF and stores the book. Requires a ProofBound account.

plugins.name: book-research
plugins.description: Build a book's pre-writing source dossier: scholarly search, a real BibTeX library, and a filed, indexed materials/ folder.

plugins.name: photo-essay
plugins.description: Turn a folder of photos into a magazine-style HTML photo essay.

plugins.name: conference-booth-report
plugins.description: Turn a folder of trade-show booth photos into a self-contained, emailable HTML report that identifies each exhibitor from its signage.
